name: Maxim M1910 on the Sokolov mount
about: Made by tools/battle-models (prop). Metres; x forward, y right, z up. A battle model: `part` says which part each point belongs to; `parts` are the parts (parent, pivot, axis of turning, way of sliding); `sockets` are named places for flash, smoke, fire and wake; `clips` move the parts. Turns: +t degrees about an axis carries p to p cos t + (axis x p) sin t + axis (axis . p)(1 - cos t), about the part's pivot. Paints: 0 upper, 1 upper2, 2 shade, 3 track, 4 rubber, 5 steel, 6 bright, 7 wood, 8 canvas, 9 glass, 10 black, 11 rust, 12 lamp, 13 white, 14 red, 15 yellow, 16 blue, 17 leather, 18 torn, 19 rope, 20 cloth, 21 skin, 22 brass, 23 link, 24 mount, 25 box

parts.name: mount
parts.note: on the ground under the turntable, between her wheels; the game places it

parts.name: cradle
parts.note: turns on the table: + the muzzle to the right (the shield turns with her)

parts.name: gun
parts.note: tips on her trunnions: + the muzzle up

sockets.name: pull
sockets.note: the trail's handle: where a man takes her to pull her along on her wheels

sockets.name: grip.gunner.l
sockets.note: the gunner's left hand on its spade grip

sockets.name: grip.gunner.r
sockets.note: the gunner's right hand on its spade grip

sockets.name: muzzle
sockets.note: the muzzle: the flash and the tracer

sockets.name: feed
sockets.note: the belt comes in here from the RIGHT: the number two's hands

sockets.name: eject
sockets.note: the empties fall out forward, under the jacket

sockets.name: box
sockets.note: the belt box on the ground at her right, outside the wheel

sockets.name: seat
sockets.note: the gunner's root: sitting (today kneeling) inside the trail's loop, his hands 0.35 m ahead on the grips, the shield before him

sockets.name: seat.loader
sockets.note: the number two, lying at her right by the belt box

traverse.what: the game swings the gun left and right about the pintle (+ to the right)

elevate.what: the game lays the muzzle up and down (+ up)

recoil.what: a shake of 3 to 5 mm back along the barrel on each round of a burst (the game's own; no clip)

gunner.what: how the gunner serves her: prone (lying behind, his elbows down) or sit (sitting on the ground behind, his knees up either side)

feed.what: the side the belt or the strip comes in from, and so where the number two is (socket seat.loader)

carry.what: when the team moves she is not lifted: the game keeps her whole and rolls her behind the gunner on her wheels, her trail's handle (socket pull) in his hand; her wheels are 0.41 m across

units: Soviet machine gun teams (and Finland's, on the same mount)
